title: Rubish: A Unix shell written in pure Ruby
summary: Rubish is a Unix shell implementation written entirely in pure Ruby, created by Ruby core contributor amatsuda. It allows developers to use Ruby's syntax for shell operations, bringing Ruby's expressive power to command-line interactions.
problem_solved: Provides an alternative Unix shell that leverages Ruby's readable and expressive syntax instead of traditional shell scripting.
why_valuable: Demonstrates Ruby's capability for system-level tooling and offers Ruby developers a familiar syntax for everyday shell tasks.
